Verses.VerseAr: يَسۡـَٔـلُكَ اَهۡلُ الۡـكِتٰبِ اَنۡ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ كِتٰبًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ‌ فَقَدۡ سَاَلُوۡا مُوۡسٰٓى اَكۡبَرَ مِنۡ ذٰلِكَ فَقَالُوۡۤا اَرِنَا اللّٰهَ جَهۡرَةً فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ بِظُلۡمِهِمۡ‌‌ۚ ثُمَّ اتَّخَذُوۡا الۡعِجۡلَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ الۡبَيِّنٰتُ فَعَفَوۡنَا عَنۡ ذٰلِكَ‌‌‌‌ۚ وَاٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسٰى سُلۡطٰنًا مُّبِيۡنًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Beloved!) The People of the Book ask you to bring down to them a Book from heaven (completely inscribed in one go)They asked Musa (Moses) for something even greater than that; they said: ‘Show us Allah visibly (in Person).’ So owing to (their) transgression (i.ethis denigrating demand) a thunderbolt seized them(They died and were later raised to life by Musa’s (Moses) prayer.) Then they adopted the calf (as their god) after the clear Signs (pointing to the Truth) had reached themThen We overlooked this (sin) as well and bestowed upon Musa (Moses) a marked dominance over them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَرَفَعۡنَا فَوۡقَهُمُ الطُّوۡرَ بِمِيۡثَاقِهِمۡ وَقُلۡنَا لَهُمُ ادۡخُلُوۡا الۡبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَّقُلۡنَا لَهُمۡ لَا تَعۡدُوۡا فِىۡ السَّبۡتِ وَاَخَذۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ مِّيۡثَاقًا غَلِيۡظًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (when the Jews again rejected the injunctions contained in the Torah,) We raised (and suspended the Mount of) Tur over them in order to take a (firm) promise from themAnd We commanded them: ‘Enter the gate (of this city - the Ailia gate) prostrating (in gratitude),’ and We (also) said to them: ‘Do not also violate the Sabbath (prohibition of fishing on Saturday), and We took from them a reiterated and firm promise.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَبِمَا نَقۡضِهِمۡ مِّيۡثَاقَهُمۡ وَكُفۡرِهِمۡ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَقَتۡلِهِمُ الۡاَنۡۢبِيَآءَ بِغَيۡرِ حَقٍّ وَّقَوۡلِهِمۡ قُلُوۡبُنَا غُلۡفٌؕ بَلۡ طَبَعَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡهَا بِكُفۡرِهِمۡ فَلَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: So (they were afflicted with punishments) because of their breaking the promise, rejecting the Revelations of Allah, killing the Prophets unjustly (and also owing to) their saying: ‘Our hearts are (wrapped) in covers.’ (Nay, that was not the truth;) the fact is that Allah has sealed their hearts due to their disbeliefSo, except for a few, they will not accept faith

Verses.VerseAr: وَّبِكُفۡرِهِمۡ وَقَوۡلِهِمۡ عَلٰى مَرۡيَمَ بُهۡتَانًا عَظِيۡمًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (moreover) owing to their rejection of faith and uttering against Maryam (Mary) a grave calumny;

Verses.VerseAr: وَّقَوۡلِهِمۡ اِنَّا قَتَلۡنَا الۡمَسِيۡحَ عِيۡسَى ابۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ رَسُوۡلَ اللّٰهِ‌ۚ وَمَا قَتَلُوۡهُ وَمَا صَلَبُوۡهُ وَلٰـكِنۡ شُبِّهَ لَهُمۡ‌ؕ وَاِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اخۡتَلَفُوۡا فِيۡهِ لَفِىۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡهُ‌ؕ مَا لَهُمۡ بِهٖ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍ اِلَّا اتِّبَاعَ الظَّنِّ‌ۚ وَمَا قَتَلُوۡهُ يَقِيۡنًاۢۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (also) because of their uttering (the boastful claim): ‘We (have) killed Allah’s Messenger, the Messiah, ‘Isa son of Maryam (Jesus son of Mary),’ whereas they neither killed nor crucified himBut (in truth) someone was made the like (of ‘Isa — Jesus) in their viewBut those who disagree about him have surely fallen prey to doubt (concerning) this (murder)They know nothing (what the truth is) except (that they are) following fancyAnd they certainly did not murder ‘Isa (Jesus).

Verses.VerseAr: بَل رَّفَعَهُ اللّٰهُ اِلَيۡهِ‌ؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ عَزِيۡزًا حَكِيۡمًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: In fact Allah lifted him up towards Himself (in heaven) and Allah is Almighty, Most Wise.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ مِّنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ اِلَّا لَيُؤۡمِنَنَّ بِهٖ قَبۡلَ مَوۡتِهٖ‌ۚ وَيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ يَكُوۡنُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ شَهِيۡدًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (shortly before the Last Hour at the time of the Messiah’s descent,) there will not be any (individual or sect) of the People of the Book but will (rightly) believe in ‘Isa (Jesus) before his death; and ‘Isa (Jesus) will bear witness to them on the Day of Resurrection.

Verses.VerseAr: فَبِظُلۡمٍ مِّنَ الَّذِيۡنَ هَادُوۡا حَرَّمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ طَيِّبٰتٍ اُحِلَّتۡ لَهُمۡ وَبِصَدِّهِمۡ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ كَثِيۡرًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then on account of injustice on the part of the Jews, We made unlawful for them (many) pure provisions that had been made lawful for them (before), and (also) for the reason that they hindered (people) at a large scale from the path of Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَخۡذِهِمُ الرِّبٰوا وَقَدۡ نُهُوۡا عَنۡهُ وَاَكۡلِهِمۡ اَمۡوَالَ النَّاسِ بِالۡبَاطِلِ‌ؕ وَاَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ مِنۡهُمۡ عَذَابًا اَلِيۡمًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (also) because of their taking usury, despite that they were forbidden to do it, and because of their usurping others’ wealth wrongfully (they were punished)And We have prepared a torturous torment for those of them who disbelieve

Verses.VerseAr: لٰـكِنِ الرّٰسِخُوۡنَ فِىۡ الۡعِلۡمِ مِنۡهُمۡ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِمَاۤ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡكَ وَمَاۤ اُنۡزِلَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ‌ؕوَالۡمُقِيۡمِيۡنَ الصَّلٰوةَ‌ وَالۡمُؤۡتُوۡنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَالۡيَوۡمِ الۡاٰخِرِؕ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ سَنُؤۡتِيۡهِمۡ اَجۡرًا عَظِيۡمًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: But those among them who possess substantial knowledge and faith (equally) believe in (the Revelation) that has been sent down to you and (the Revelation) that was sent down before youAnd (how righteous they are!) they establish the Prayer regularly, and pay Zakat (the Alms-due) persistently, and keep faith in Allah and the Day of ResurrectionThey are the ones who We shall soon pay a mighty wage.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّاۤ اَوۡحَيۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡكَ كَمَاۤ اَوۡحَيۡنَاۤ اِلٰى نُوۡحٍ وَّالنَّبِيّٖنَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهٖ‌ۚ وَاَوۡحَيۡنَاۤ اِلٰٓى اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَاِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ وَالۡاَسۡبَاطِ وَعِيۡسٰى وَاَيُّوۡبَ وَيُوۡنُسَ وَهٰرُوۡنَ وَسُلَيۡمٰنَ‌ۚ وَاٰتَيۡنَا دَاوٗدَ زَبُوۡرًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Beloved!) Indeed We have sent Revelation to you as We sent it to Nuh (Noah) and (other) Messengers after him; and We also sent Revelation to Ibrahim (Abraham), Isma‘il (Ishmael), Ishaq (Isaac), Ya‘qub (Jacob) and (his) children and ‘Isa (Jesus), Ayyub (Job), Yunus (Jonah), Harun (Aaron) and Sulaiman (Solomon); and We conferred the Zabur (Book of Psalms) upon Dawud (David)

Verses.VerseAr: وَرُسُلاً قَدۡ قَصَصۡنٰهُمۡ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَرُسُلاً لَّمۡ نَقۡصُصۡهُمۡ عَلَيۡكَ‌ؕ وَكَلَّمَ اللّٰهُ مُوۡسٰى تَكۡلِيۡمًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (We have sent many) Messengers whose annals We have narrated to you earlier; and We sent (a number of) those Messengers whose details We have not (yet) related to you; and Allah (also) spoke to Musa ([Moses] directly).

Verses.VerseAr: رُّسُلاً مُّبَشِّرِيۡنَ وَمُنۡذِرِيۡنَ لِئَلَّا يَكُوۡنَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى اللّٰهِ حُجَّةٌۢ بَعۡدَ الرُّسُلِ‌ؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ عَزِيۡزًا حَكِيۡمًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Messengers who were Bearers of good news and Warners (were sent) so that after (the arrival of these) Messengers people may not have any plea against AllahAnd Allah is Almighty, Most Wise

Verses.VerseAr: لٰـكِنِ اللّٰهُ يَشۡهَدُ بِمَاۤ اَنۡزَلَ اِلَيۡكَ‌ اَنۡزَلَهٗ بِعِلۡمِهٖ‌ۚ وَالۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةُ يَشۡهَدُوۡنَ‌ؕ وَكَفٰى بِاللّٰهِ شَهِيۡدًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Beloved! Whether somebody believes in your Prophethood or not,) Allah (Himself) bears witness to (this fact that) whatever He has sent down to you has sent down with His knowledgeAnd the angels (too) bear witness to that effect (for your sake), and Allah is All-Sufficient as a witness.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَصَدُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ قَدۡ ضَلُّوۡا ضَلٰلاًۢ بَعِيۡدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Verily, those who disbelieved (i.ebelied the Prophethood of Muhammad [blessings and peace be upon him] and hindered (people) from the path of Allah, they undoubtedly went far astray (from the Truth).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَظَلَمُوۡا لَمۡ يَكُنِ اللّٰهُ لِيَـغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا لِيَـهۡدِيَهُمۡ طَرِيۡقًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed those who have disbelieved (by denying Allah’s witness) and done injustice (by denying the Messenger’s glory), Allah will by no means forgive them, nor will show them any path (on the Day of Judgment),

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا طَرِيۡقَ جَهَـنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاۤ اَبَدًا‌ؕ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ يَسِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except the path of Hell wherein they shall dwell beyond the count of time and that is easy for Allah

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدۡ جَآءَكُمُ الرَّسُوۡلُ بِالۡحَـقِّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ فَاٰمِنُوۡا خَيۡرًا لَّـكُمۡ‌ؕ وَاِنۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡا فَاِنَّ لِلّٰهِ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ عَلِيۡمًا حَكِيۡمًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: O mankind! Indeed this Messenger (blessings and peace be upon him) has come to you with the Truth from your LordSo believe (in him) for your own goodBut if you disbelieve (i.edeny his Prophethood then bear in mind that He is Beyond Any Need of you because) whatever is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah indeedAnd Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَهۡلَ الۡكِتٰبِ لَا تَغۡلُوۡا فِىۡ دِيۡنِكُمۡ وَلَا تَقُوۡلُوۡا عَلَى اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الۡحَـقَّ‌ؕ اِنَّمَا الۡمَسِيۡحُ عِيۡسَى ابۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ رَسُوۡلُ اللّٰهِ وَكَلِمَتُهٗ‌ۚ اَلۡقٰٮهَاۤ اِلٰى مَرۡيَمَ وَرُوۡحٌ مِّنۡهُ‌ فَاٰمِنُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ وَرُسُلِهٖ‌‌ۚ وَلَا تَقُوۡلُوۡا ثَلٰثَةٌ‌ ؕ انتَهُوۡا خَيۡرًا لَّـكُمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّمَا اللّٰهُ اِلٰـهٌ وَّاحِدٌ‌ ؕ سُبۡحٰنَهٗۤ اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ لَهٗ وَلَدٌ‌ۘ لَهٗ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ وَكَفٰى بِاللّٰهِ وَكِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: O People of the Book! Exceed not the limits in your Din (Religion) and speak nothing but the truth about Allah’s gloryThe fact is simple that the Messiah, ‘Isa son of Maryam (Jesus son of Mary), is Allah’s Messenger and His Word which He conveyed to Maryam (Mary) and a Spirit from HimSo believe in Allah and His Messengers and do not say: ‘There are three (Gods).’ Refrain (from this belief); (that) is best for youVerily, Allah is the Only One God, Holy is He, far above having a sonWhatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth (all) belongs to Him aloneAnd Sufficient is Allah as Guardian.

Verses.VerseAr: لَنۡ يَّسۡتَـنۡكِفَ الۡمَسِيۡحُ اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ عَبۡدًا لِّلَّهِ وَلَا الۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةُ الۡمُقَرَّبُوۡنَ‌ؕ وَمَنۡ يَّسۡتَـنۡكِفۡ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهٖ وَيَسۡتَكۡبِرۡ فَسَيَحۡشُرُهُمۡ اِلَيۡهِ جَمِيۡعًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Messiah feels no embarrassment in being a servant of AllahNor do the closest angels (ever feel ashamed)And whoever disdains to be His servant and perpetrates arrogance, He will soon assemble together all such people before Him.

Words.MeaningEn: the ones who are near (to Allah)

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيۡهِمۡ اُجُوۡرَهُمۡ وَيَزِيۡدُهُمۡ مِّنۡ فَضۡلِهٖ‌ۚ وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَـنۡكَفُوۡا وَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا فَيُعَذِّبُهُمۡ عَذَابًا اَلِيۡمًاۙ وَّلَا يَجِدُوۡنَ لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَلِيًّا وَّلَا نَصِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: So those who believe and persist in doing pious deeds He will pay them their wages in full and will (then) award them more out of His BountyBut those who disdain (worshipping Allah) and behave arrogantly, He will punish them with grievous torment, and they will not find for them any friend or helper besides Allah.

Words.MeaningEn: then He will give them in full

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ بُرۡهَانٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ وَاَنۡزَلۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡكُمۡ نُوۡرًا مُّبِيۡنًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: O mankind! (The most vital, perfect, clear and) a conclusive evidence has reached you from your (Ever-Glorious and Most Exalted) Lord (in the form of the Holy Being of the Prophet Muhammad [blessings and peace be upon him])And (besides) We have (also) sent down to you the brightening and radiant light (in the shape of the Holy Qur’an)

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ وَاعۡتَصَمُوۡا بِهٖ فَسَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ فِىۡ رَحۡمَةٍ مِّنۡهُ وَفَضۡلٍۙ وَّيَهۡدِيۡهِمۡ اِلَيۡهِ صِرَاطًا مُّسۡتَقِيۡمًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, those who believe in Allah and hold fast to His (embrace, Allah) will soon admit them to His (exceptional) Mercy and Grace and will show them the straight path to (reach) Him.

Verses.VerseAr: يَسۡتَفۡتُوۡنَكَؕ قُلِ اللّٰهُ يُفۡتِيۡكُمۡ فِىۡ الۡـكَلٰلَةِ‌ؕ اِنِ امۡرُؤٌا هَلَكَ لَـيۡسَ لَهٗ وَلَدٌ وَّلَهٗۤ اُخۡتٌ فَلَهَا نِصۡفُ مَا تَرَكَ‌ۚ وَهُوَ يَرِثُهَاۤ اِنۡ لَّمۡ يَكُنۡ لَّهَا وَلَدٌ‌ ؕ فَاِنۡ كَانَتَا اثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَلَهُمَا الثُّلُثٰنِ مِمَّا تَرَكَ‌ؕ وَاِنۡ كَانُوۡۤا اِخۡوَةً رِّجَالاً وَّنِسَآءً فَلِلذَّكَرِ مِثۡلُ حَظِّ الۡاُنۡثَيَيۡنِ‌ؕ يُبَيِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَـكُمۡ اَنۡ تَضِلُّوۡا‌ؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِكُلِّ شَىۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They seek edict (i.ejudgment under Islamic Law) from youSay: Allah ordains pertaining to (the inheritance of) kalala (the deceased leaving neither children nor parents behind): If a man dies childless but has one sister, she shall have (as her share) half (the property) that he leaves(If, on the contrary, a sister is kalala, then in the case of her death) the brother will be (the sole) heir (to his sister), if she has no childrenThen if (after a kalala brother’s death) two (sisters) are (the heirs), they are entitled to share two-thirds of (the property) he leavesAnd if (in the case of the deceased who is kalala) he has some brothers and sisters, male (as well as) female heirs, then the share of each male shall be as much as the (portion of) two females?
